dedupe_keys.name: four country consumer repair reuse and recycling survey 2024

description: This dataset records circular-economy attitudes and behaviour among 4,216 adult consumers in Germany, Italy, India and South Africa. The Circomod research collaborators used a stratified online panel in March–April 2024, with at least one thousand respondents per country, to study electronics and furniture repair, reuse, recycling, refurbishment and sharing. Zenodo provides raw and recoded responses, a codebook, survey instruments and R recoding material in spreadsheet and statistical formats. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is the four surveyed countries, with English, German, Italian, Hindi and Zulu questionnaire versions listed. Online recruitment and self-reported intentions are limitations when predicting actual material flows or participation. Modellers could parameterise household decisions in agent-based or waste-demand simulations. model-comses-residents-waste-sorting-planned-behaviour offers a related behavioural model. No respondent data, questionnaire PDF or recoding script was downloaded, and cross-country measurement equivalence was not checked.
